notes: The music video is on the now bar now, at the right-hand end of the DJ MODE and LYRICS row - beside the song it plays for, instead of a page away on the side rail. One tap opens the same viewer it always did.
The cloud layout keeps its controls on one line and hides that row, so it gets the little camera beside the Lyrics icon instead, at the same size and in the same place.
The side rail is cleaner. The song’s ... menu is gone from it: the same sheet is on the now bar and on the song’s own row, so a third door over the artwork was one door too many.

The rail’s first glyph is no longer all songs and nothing else. It is Playlists, and it opens every playlist in the strip with the songs listed under it - all of your playlists and all of your songs in one place - with Albums beside it.
Two glyphs, one hairline and the same drag order: a glyph you move is still where you left it next launch.
